{{Quote|A Nautolan. Pretty far from an ocean, aren't you?''"<br />"''I'm waiting.''"<br />"''No sense of humor. All right: Alderaan has three moons.''"<br />"''Demos Four but two.|[[Sheeka Tull]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]|<ref name="TCD">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref>}}
'''Demos Four''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with two [[Moon/Legends|moons]], located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was located on the [[Dustig Trace]], nearby to the [[Tyus Cluster/Legends|Tyus Cluster]].
